title: The state of the domains Woodcore writes
description: data/domain-state.json -- for each calculation domain Woodcore wrote from its data (a member check unfolded so far, every domain of the spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte as its generators come), where its file stands against a new writing of it: the form it was written for and the form its data asks for now, whether the two are one, and the lines Woodcore could not apply -- a line the writing has and the file not, a line changed on both sides (REQ-012, ARCH-007). Computed by Python at each export (calc/domains/unfold.py `domain_state`) and read by Typst: `#domain` prints in red at its head what this says, so that a file Woodcore does not rewrite still says it no longer matches its data, and the summary of the checks knows a check's domain by its `check`. Written whole, sorted, no date; never edited by hand.

schema_version.description: 1.0 -- a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

domains.description: One entry per domain Woodcore wrote, keyed by its id.

kind.description: What wrote it: `check` for a member check unfolded.

check.description: For a member check, its kind -- `tension` -- which the summary of the checks names it by.

written.description: The form the file was written for: {kind, form, version}, as the base keeps it.

form.description: The form its data asks for now: {kind, form, version}; null where the check is no longer written out.

matches.description: Whether the two forms are one: false prints the domain's red line.

gone.description: True where the domain's check is no longer in the export, or no longer written out.

missing.description: The lines of a new writing the file does not hold (`var:N_t_d`), not applied.

conflict.description: The lines changed in the file and in the data alike, not applied.

file.description: Its file from the Typst root.
